title: Superheroes: Powers and Origins
description: Origins, secret identities, and superpowers—hero lore in five steps.

questions.question: What planet is Superman from?
questions.hint: A destroyed planet that sounds like a science gas

questions.question: After leaving Krypton, Superman was raised on what planet?
On Earth, what gives Spider-Man his powers?
questions.hint: A tiny creature plus dangerous radiation

questions.question: Spider-Man's real name is Peter Parker—what is Batman's?
questions.hint: A rich Gotham citizen named Bruce

questions.question: Bruce Wayne fights crime as Batman; who gets stronger when angry?
questions.hint: He turns green and smashes things
